title: Talk 2

title: Talk 3
original: Oh, you've noticed my blade? I was told it can erase history's mistakes, but that's practically half of whatever's been archived in the last thousand years, and there's no way a single blade could clean that all up. Let's look to the future instead—the ideals we seek still lie ahead.

title: Talk after Promotion 1
original: I followed her and Reunion to many places, and saw many sacrifices made. The people went from being lost and fragmented to becoming united and awakened—on that long and winding road. Many of them were left behind in the huge blaze in Deity Grypherburg, yet it was this very fire that ignited their hope.

title: Talk after Promotion 2
original: We're a long way from a place where everyone is treated equally, and I have no clue if I'm any nearer to this goal. But I've never doubted the equality I envision is real, for when we step up to rage against the injustice we see, we prove it exists.

title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
original: I've been back to Lungmen a few times. Other than the loss of my favorite cheongfun shop, the changes are nice to see. There are fewer L.G.D. patrols on the streets, and you hear less talk of the slums… There's no lying to myself and pretending I don't care for the city.

title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
original: I asked that man why my mother and sister had to suffer, and unsurprisingly, I didn't get the answer I was looking for. It's too bad Chi Xiao can't sever blood ties, and this writing knife can't scrape away recorded history either. There's no granting any forgiveness in their stead, no one is worth sacrificing for any 'greater good', ever.

title: Anniversary Celebration
original: I remember the first time I collaborated with Rhodes Island. A difficult fight, but a single Black Snake is nothing to worry about.
